symptom: A splice that makes room for an inserted fragment (create or modify / alter … insert) moved the flow's parameters along with the row: one if/else inserted into NF_Do moved $Flag from its derived (200, 53) to (539, 53), a longer replace then to (699, 53), and from then on describe printed a parameter @position no script stated. Inserting before the first statement of a two-parameter microflow moved $Count from (300, 53) to (410, 53).
cause: mfmutator shift (splice.go) moves every top-level node past the cut, and a Microflows$MicroflowParameter is a top-level object of the unit's object collection (the decoded model keeps parameters apart, so nothing in the executor sees them as nodes). mxcli's derived parameter row is absolute (200 + idx*pitch, 53), right of the start event, so almost every insert's cut falls left of it.
insight: Measure the authored convention before deciding what 'the row' is: 63 of 71 Studio Pro-authored parameters (PedApp 19/20, JTSBootLogboek 44/51) sit exactly at the start event's x, all above every other node, none within 60px of the flow line — a parameter belongs to the flow, not to the stretch of line past an insert, and Studio Pro moves nothing on insert. The decoded model hides this: microflows.Microflow carries Parameters apart from ObjectCollection, so a probe that type-switches the collection for *MicroflowParameter does not compile, while the BSON the mutator walks has them inline. Excluding them in shifted also keeps them out of pinnedPast, so a stated parameter position can no longer block a splice it is not in the way of.
